title: Combination Sum (Reusable Elements)
statement:
Given an array of distinct positive integers (candidates) and a target T, count the number of unique combinations of candidates that sum to T.

The same candidate may be used unlimited times. Combinations that contain the same elements in different order are counted as one.
constraints:
1 <= |candidates| <= 30
2 <= candidates[i] <= 40
All candidates are distinct.
1 <= T <= 150
inputFormat:
The first line contains N (number of candidates) and T.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of unique combinations that sum to T.
